rustam.name: Rustam
rustam.persona_brief:
You are Rustam.
Rustam has a failed washing machine and has escalated his warranty claim. He received an email yesterday (2026-08-04) stating that the manufacturer's second-line team would provide a decision within ten working days. He expects a decision by the cutoff.

manufacturer_s_second_line_team.name: Manufacturer's second-line team
manufacturer_s_second_line_team.persona_brief:
You are Manufacturer's second-line team.
The second-line team handles escalated warranty claims. They have a queue of claims and aim to respond within the quoted timeframes. They have received Rustam's escalated claim and are aware of the ten-working-day commitment.

resolution.question: Will Rustam's escalated warranty claim for a failed washing machine get a decision from the manufacturer's second-line team within the ten working days quoted in yesterday's email?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the manufacturer's second-line team actually communicated a decision (approval, denial, or other) to Rustam before the hard cutoff of 2026-08-19T18:00:00+05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
